headline: Reset Ashford's discount from 23.5% to 15.4% to recover ₹21,794/month margin and restore the account to healthy.
rationale: Discount crept from 12.7% to 23.5% and margin rate fell from 22.6% to 11.5% with no offsetting volume gain — a structural pricing leak, not a one-off. The 15.4% option is the smallest reduction that fully restores the account to healthy (short_of_healthy_by_pp 0.0).
why_not_more_aggressive: Pushing to the original 12.7% only adds ₹7,256 more per month over the 15.4% option but the 15.4% option already restores the account to healthy — no extra benefit for the harder ask.
why_not_less_aggressive: The 19.9% and 18.1% options recover ₹9,576 and ₹14,512 respectively but both leave the account short of healthy by 4.2 and 2.3 points.
expected_result: Bringing the discount down to 15.4% recovers ₹21,794 in margin per month (₹261,533 over 12 months), lifts the margin rate to 19.9%, and returns the account to healthy.
what_to_do: Pull Ashford's last 3 invoices and show the discount trail moving from 12.7% to 23.5% since October 2025.
Present the margin rate fall from 22.6% to 11.5% alongside the discount trail in the renewal meeting.
Propose resetting the discount to 15.4%, framed as restoring normal terms rather than a price increase.

Flag PT-Rotary Hammer SDS (down from Rs 21,681.85 to Rs 7,421.55/month) and PH-Precision Torque Wrench (Rs 14,691.08/month, now zero) as separate range/selling issues to raise once pricing is settled.
Get sign-off from Anil Kumar and confirm the new rate in the next order confirmation.
talking_points: Your discount has moved from 12.7% to 23.5% since October 2025 with no change in order size.
Margin rate on this account has been below normal range for 10 straight months, now at 11.5%.
Rotary Hammer SDS orders have dropped from Rs 21,681.85 to Rs 7,421.55 a month — separate from the pricing conversation.
check_before_acting: Confirm current contract or tier terms don't already entitle Ashford to a higher discount band.
Establish whether PH-Precision Torque Wrench and CN-Drill Bit Set stopped due to Ashford's own range change, not price.
Check if a competitor or internal promotion drove the discount increase from October 2025.
downside_if_wrong: Ashford could reduce volume by up to 48% before this stops paying, though this is a tolerance limit, not a forecast.
timing: At next commercial review, within this quarter
how_we_will_know_it_worked: Average discount recorded at 15.4% or lower on next month's invoices.
Margin rate back at or above 19.9% within 2-3 months.
Monthly margin recovery of ₹21,794 visible in next quarter's account review.
